experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the iconic Tsukiji Outer Market, sampling fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, and street snacks from legendary vendors. Engage with local fishmongers and food artisans who have operated for generations, offering an authentic taste of Tokyo's culinary soul.

experiences.name: Akihabara Tech and Anime District Exploration
experiences.description: Dive deep into Tokyo's electric town, visiting multi-floor electronics shops, retro gaming arcades, maid cafes, and cutting-edge gadget stores. Experience the epicenter of Japan's otaku and tech culture, from robot demonstrations to the latest consumer electronics.

experiences.name: Senso-ji Temple and Asakusa Cultural Walk
experiences.description: Visit Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, strolling through the Nakamise shopping street lined with traditional crafts and snacks. Witness morning prayers, explore the five-story pagoda, and immerse yourself in centuries of Edo-period culture and architecture.

experiences.name: Ramen Alley Tasting Experience in Shinjuku
experiences.description: Navigate the narrow, atmospheric lanes of Shinjuku's Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane) and nearby ramen shops, tasting regional ramen styles from tonkotsu to miso. Sit elbow-to-elbow with locals at tiny counters for an unforgettable, immersive dining experience.

experiences.name: teamLab Borderless Digital Art Museum
experiences.description: Experience one of the world's most innovative digital art installations where technology and culture merge into breathtaking immersive environments. Walk through rooms of interactive light, sound, and projection art created by the pioneering teamLab collective, blending Japanese aesthetics with futuristic tech.
